messages:
Nina Alvarez: heads up team — webinar signups are getting stuck waiting for enrichment and we lose the first-touch window (~5-9m). need a fast-path for event leads.
Tom Becker: agreed. proposal: immediate round-robin to 'webinar-sdr' with minimal metadata, mark lead.partial=true. enrichment job should PATCH profile fields only and must not change owner if one exists. SLA target: 6m accept window for the event queue.
Priya Rao: thumbs up. on HubSpot we'll add a query flag quick_route=true and meta owner_policy=preserve. workflow: if quick_route==true -> RR to webinar-sdr and set partial_profile=true.
Eli Woods: important — Salesforce connector also needs preserve_owner=true on upsert to avoid SF automations stealing assignment. I'll add unit tests for that.
Tom Becker: fallback: if no accept in 6m, auto-escalate to overflow-sdr and post note "auto-escalated after 6m no-accept". also tag in #marketing-sdr.
eng-sync-bot: webhook smoke OK (200). sample incoming payload (string-escaped in logs): {"email":"attendee@org.com","campaign":"q2-webinar","quick_route":"true","x-rollout":"canary"}
Priya Rao: canary plan: start at 3% traffic with header x-rollout=canary. monitor: acceptance_rate, median_accept_ms, owner_flip_count, conversion_24h. alert if median_accept_ms > 360000ms or acceptance_rate < 65% in first 30m.
Nina Alvarez: SDR playbook bullets: 1) call within 6m, 2) verify basic info (name/company/role), 3) log note "partial-profile follow-up", 4) if critical fields missing, use backup-email flow. I'll drop a short script in #marketing.
Eli Woods: enrichment job will PATCH these fields when ready: title, company_size, lead_score. PATCH must be non-destructive to owner id. sample patch logged: PATCH /leads/:id {"lead_score":58,"company":"Acme"} — no owner field.
Tom Becker: observability: emit events lead.routed.webinar, lead.accept.ms, lead.enrich.latency. dashboards: rolling 30m for acceptance_rate and owner_flip_ratio. set alerts to page oncall if owner_flip_rate > 0.05.
Nina Alvarez: timeline: implement hubspot flag + connector preserve semantics today, canary tomorrow 09:00, ramp to 25% after 2h if healthy. post-mortem check after event: compare 24h conversion vs baseline, owner churn rate, and median accept latency.
Priya Rao: one more thing — enrichment occasionally spikes to 15m. policy: do not block routing after 3m; route with partial profile. enrichment patch only updates metadata and quality score.
Tom Becker: I'll prepare the canary rollout steps and a rollback checklist. thanks all. :rocket:
